end.summary:
Pihu named ants and beetles as animals found in soil or leaf litter.
Pihu described earthworm tunnels as allowing air and water into soil and making it loose.
Pihu repeatedly said earthworms spoil soil, eat crop roots, and should be removed or killed.
The earthworm misconception was still present at the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised naming small soil animals and used the tunnel idea to explain how earthworms let air and water into soil. Garden and leaf-litter examples helped Pihu give the tunnel explanation, but Pihu continued to mix up earthworms as harmful and this was not corrected by the end. At home, look under leaves together and discuss how earthworms help soil; please avoid harming them.
